_about: Hand-written names and look briefs for the realms and scenes. Edit freely. 'tower' names each realm's fast-travel tower. 'anchors' are each scene's top artists; build/export_unity.py warns if a scene id no longer contains them (for example after scenes.py renumbers scenes).

realms.name: The Old Kingdoms
realms.note: Classic, jam, prog, southern, glam and heavy metal: the old heartland of rock.

realms.name: Riffland
realms.note: Alternative, grunge, punk, emo, metalcore, prog metal and J-rock.

realms.name: The Indie Isles
realms.note: Indie rock, shoegaze, bedroom pop and indie folk.

realms.name: The Bass Reaches
realms.note: Every kind of electronic music, from ambient to riddim.

realms.name: The Chart Isles
realms.note: Pop, electropop, synthwave, country and Latin.

realms.name: The Groovelands
realms.note: Soul, funk, disco, world music and jazz.

realms.name: The Isles of Story
realms.note: Film scores, classical, musicals, game music and novelties.

scenes.name: The Jam Band Commonwealth
scenes.terrain: Vast rolling woods cut by long winding trails that loop back on themselves; open meadows used as festival lawns.
scenes.landmark: An amphitheatre in a forest bowl, with a giant hot-air balloon tethered above the stage.
scenes.props: Tour vans, tie-dye tapestries strung between trees, campfires, banjos on cabin porches, glowsticks hanging from branches.
scenes.mood: Golden late afternoon that slides into a lantern-lit night.

scenes.name: Metalcore Caldera
scenes.terrain: A ring of black volcanoes around a sunken crater; lava cracks in the ground, ash drifting down.
scenes.landmark: A circular pit arena in the crater floor, ringed by a rim of glowing lava.
scenes.props: Toppled amp stacks, chain-link fences, jagged obsidian spires, steam vents, broken drumsticks.
scenes.mood: Overcast and smoky, lit red from below.

scenes.name: Kingdom of Classic Rock
scenes.terrain: Old green hills worn smooth, crossed by two-lane highways and stone bridges.
scenes.landmark: A crumbling stadium crowning the highest hill, like a castle.
scenes.props: Standing stones shaped like vinyl records, jukeboxes, vintage cars, monolith-sized amplifiers, a brightly painted submarine on the lake.

scenes.name: The Country Plains
scenes.terrain: Endless flat wheat fields and gentle swells under an enormous sky; a dirt road to the horizon.
scenes.landmark: A big red barn dance hall next to a water tower.
scenes.props: Pickup trucks, hay bales, split-rail fences, a windmill, porch rocking chairs, a lone gas station.

scenes.name: The Alt Rock Moors
scenes.terrain: Grey-green moorland with dry-stone walls, low hills and scattered towns.
scenes.landmark: A giant radio transmitter on the tallest hill, its warning lights blinking.
scenes.props: Phone boxes, satellite dishes, power lines, stone walls, a lonely bus stop.
scenes.mood: Moody overcast with sudden breaks of sun.

scenes.name: The Psychedelic Wilds
scenes.terrain: Hot desert mesas with swirling strata that melt into a forest of giant mushrooms.
scenes.landmark: A towering spiral mushroom, taller than the mesas.
scenes.props: Lava-lamp plants, painted camper vans, crystals, cacti, a dusty desert stage.
scenes.mood: Heat haze, with a sky that slowly shifts colour.

scenes.name: The Punk Badlands
scenes.terrain: Scrappy badlands of eroded rock with suburban ruins; skate bowls carved into the ground.
scenes.landmark: A giant drained swimming pool turned into a skatepark.
scenes.props: Graffiti walls, shopping carts, chain-link, battered mailboxes, half-pipes, spray cans.

scenes.name: The Math Rock Escarpment
scenes.terrain: Sheer cliffs cut into geometric terraces, stepping down to a calm sea; waterfalls everywhere.
scenes.landmark: A lone wooden house on the cliff edge beside a huge waterfall.
scenes.props: Basalt columns, wind chimes, string lights, drifts of fallen leaves.

scenes.name: The Shoegaze Fens
scenes.terrain: A reverb-drowned marsh of reeds, still pools and willows.
scenes.landmark: A ruined cathedral half-sunk in the marsh, glowing softly inside.
scenes.props: Reeds, floating petals, old guitar pedals used as stepping stones, weeping willows.
scenes.mood: Permanent soft fog and heavy bloom.

scenes.name: The Indie Downs
scenes.terrain: Rolling chalk downs with small market towns and hedgerows.
scenes.landmark: A giant guitar cut into the chalk of a hillside.
scenes.props: A record shop, bicycles, bunting, gig posters on lamp posts, a small branch-line train.
scenes.mood: Soft overcast with patches of sun.

scenes.name: The Pop Republic
scenes.terrain: Candy-coloured hills around a crowded boardwalk city.
scenes.landmark: A glittering stage-palace with a ferris wheel behind it.
scenes.props: Billboards, confetti cannons, fountains, neon signs, a red carpet.

scenes.name: The Hip-Hop Boroughs
scenes.terrain: Dense city blocks on mesa tops, linked by bridges across the gaps.
scenes.landmark: A tower with a rooftop stage and a giant boombox on top.
scenes.props: Graffiti, sneakers hanging on wires, fire hydrants, basketball courts, lowriders.

scenes.name: The Grunge Rainwood
scenes.terrain: Dripping pine forest on steep slopes, with muddy logging roads.
scenes.landmark: An old sawmill turned into a venue, next to a roaring waterfall.
scenes.props: Logging trucks, rusted trailers, flannel shirts on clotheslines, a coffee shack.

scenes.name: The Yacht Rock Riviera
scenes.terrain: Palm-lined coves, white-sand beaches and a calm marina.
scenes.landmark: A white yacht club whose pier is shaped like a piano keyboard.
scenes.props: Sailboats, deck chairs, cocktail umbrellas, white grand pianos, palm trees.

scenes.name: Lanternwood
scenes.terrain: Birch woods dusted with snow, small clearings and a frozen creek.
scenes.landmark: A small abandoned chapel full of candles.
scenes.props: Hanging lanterns, log cabins, canoes, stacked firewood, a lute resting on a stump.

scenes.name: The Driftwood Shore
scenes.terrain: Sheltered beach coves, tide pools and low sea cliffs.
scenes.landmark: A giant driftwood arch over a lagoon, with a rainbow that never quite fades.
scenes.props: Surfboards, hammocks, acoustic guitars, beach huts, tide pools.

scenes.name: The Prog Marches
scenes.terrain: Wide, strange marchland with impossible geometry and roads that run in long odd loops.
scenes.landmark: A giant crystal prism on a plain, splitting a beam of light across the valley.
scenes.props: Observatories, giant clockwork, standing stones spaced in 7/8, old organs left in fields.
scenes.mood: Twilight with the stars already out.

scenes.name: The Folk Woods
scenes.terrain: Old-growth forest around a mountain lake, with a railway along the shore.
scenes.landmark: A huge old tree with a small stage built around its roots.
scenes.props: Campfires, canoes, train tracks, wooden cabins, a harmonica left on a stump.

scenes.name: The Djent Spires
scenes.terrain: Precise crystal spires and terraced cliffs with clean, fractal edges.
scenes.landmark: A floating fractal citadel above the highest spire.
scenes.props: Geometric monoliths, floating cubes, Tesla coils, bridges strung like guitar strings.

scenes.name: The Melodic Bass Highlands
scenes.terrain: Big summits rising above a sea of clouds.
scenes.landmark: A glowing ring-shaped stage floating over the highest peak.
scenes.props: Floating lanterns, crystal shards, waterfalls pouring into the clouds.

scenes.name: The Ambient Mists
scenes.terrain: Soft, low hills fading into fog around a large still lake.
scenes.landmark: A lone tree on an island in the lake, with an old radio tower behind it.
scenes.props: Tall grass, old TV sets, power lines, sheep, a rowing boat.

scenes.name: The Post-Punk Docklands
scenes.terrain: A grey industrial harbour of quays, warehouses and brutalist blocks.
scenes.landmark: A brutalist tower block with a single lit window.
scenes.props: Cranes, shipping containers, flyers on walls, phone booths, rain puddles.

scenes.name: The Heartbreak Boardwalk
scenes.terrain: A faded seaside boardwalk with motels and a long pier.
scenes.landmark: A half-lit ferris wheel at the end of the pier.
scenes.props: Vintage cars, motel signs, prom balloons, roses, payphones.

scenes.name: The Four-on-the-Floor Steppe
scenes.terrain: Flat grassland laid out in a grid of glowing dance floors.
scenes.landmark: A giant mirror ball hanging from a crane over the central floor.
scenes.props: Speaker stacks, light towers, lasers, chrome DJ booths.
scenes.mood: Night lit by lasers until sunrise.

scenes.name: The Dubstep Shards
scenes.terrain: Jagged crystal mountains split by deep cracks.
scenes.landmark: A cracked mountain with a chasm that pulses with light.
scenes.props: Boulders shaped like subwoofers, broken crystals, warning lights, thick cables.

scenes.name: Boom Bap Harbour
scenes.terrain: Brownstone streets running down to a sunny harbour beach.
scenes.landmark: An elevated train line over a block-party stage, with a beach sound system below.
scenes.props: Boomboxes, turntables, stoops, sound-system speaker stacks, palm trees.

scenes.name: The Isle of Memes & Musicals
scenes.terrain: A storybook island of round hills and winding paths.
scenes.landmark: A storybook castle with a theatre curtain for a front gate.
scenes.props: Spotlights, oversized props, singing flowers, rubber chickens, a suspicious duck.

scenes.name: The Iron Range
scenes.terrain: The tallest peaks in the world, honeycombed with mines.
scenes.landmark: A forge inside the highest peak, pouring a river of molten metal.
scenes.props: Mine carts, chains, anvils, skull-shaped rocks, rusted gates.

scenes.name: The J-Rock Isles
scenes.terrain: A dense neon city on steep islands, softened by cherry trees.
scenes.landmark: A torii gate on a rooftop high above the city.
scenes.props: Vending machines, train crossings, paper lanterns, cherry trees, tangles of power lines.
scenes.mood: Dramatic dusk sky with big clouds.

scenes.name: The Soul Lowlands
scenes.terrain: Warm river country with slow bends and wooden towns.
scenes.landmark: A riverside theatre with a lit-up marquee, next to a white chapel.
scenes.props: Jukeboxes, porch swings, vintage microphones, riverboats, choir risers.

scenes.name: The Funk Tropics
scenes.terrain: Lush, sweaty jungle laid out entirely on the one.
scenes.landmark: A flying saucer landed in a jungle clearing, its ramp turned into a stage.
scenes.props: Vines like bass strings, disco-ball fruit, horn-shaped flowers, platform-shoe stepping stones.

scenes.name: The Glitterlands
scenes.terrain: Floating candy-and-chrome platforms joined by bouncy bridges.
scenes.landmark: A chrome disco tower topped with a giant inflatable heart.
scenes.props: Inflatables, glitter piles, laser rigs, pink cowboy hats, trampolines.

scenes.name: The Nu Metal Quarry
scenes.terrain: A huge open-pit quarry with rusted machinery on the terraces.
scenes.landmark: A stage built on an old mining rig at the bottom of the pit.
scenes.props: Chain-link, burning oil drums, pickup trucks, wrecked cars.

scenes.name: The IDM Glitchlands
scenes.terrain: Unstable ground that splits and rearranges itself into new shapes.
scenes.landmark: A broken floating island that keeps reassembling itself.
scenes.props: Corrupted cubes, wireframe trees, flickering pixel blocks.

scenes.name: The Southern Rock Bayou
scenes.terrain: Cypress swamp and slow brown rivers, between the rock hills and the country plains.
scenes.landmark: A juke joint on stilts under a huge oak hung with Spanish moss.
scenes.props: Rocking chairs, motorcycles, pickup trucks, a slide guitar on the porch, fireflies.

scenes.name: The Oddball Backroads
scenes.terrain: Winding rural back roads that feel slightly wrong, overgrown with kudzu.
scenes.landmark: A roadside attraction: a giant fibreglass head beside a crooked water tower.
scenes.props: Plastic lawn flamingos, junk sculptures, thrift-store couches, a hand-painted sign.

scenes.name: Studio Lot Island
scenes.terrain: A film studio back lot where sets from different films stand side by side.
scenes.landmark: A giant soundstage with an Italian piazza front next to a sci-fi set.
scenes.props: Clapperboards, spotlights, film reels, fake columns, camera cranes.

scenes.name: The Lo-Fi Hills
scenes.terrain: Gentle, rain-soaked slopes with a few lit-up houses.
scenes.landmark: A hillside study tower with one big lit window and a desk lamp.
scenes.props: Potted plants, sleeping cats, cassette tapes, vinyl, vending machines, puddles.

scenes.name: The Hair Metal Strip
scenes.terrain: A neon boulevard winding through a dry desert valley.
scenes.landmark: A giant neon-lit club with pyrotechnic jets on its roof.
scenes.props: Motorcycles, giant hairspray cans, leopard-print awnings, pyro jets.

scenes.name: The Isle of Scores
scenes.terrain: Sweeping cliffs and plateaus under a huge sky.
scenes.landmark: An orchestra amphitheatre carved into a cliff face.
scenes.props: Music stands, marble statues, grand pianos, a conductor's podium, banners.
scenes.mood: Epic golden light with drifting clouds.

scenes.name: The Far Shores
scenes.terrain: A tropical coastline that turns into desert dunes inland.
scenes.landmark: A wavy mosaic promenade leading inland to a desert tent camp.
scenes.props: Hammocks, beach bars, desert tents, record crates, old radios.

scenes.name: The Fusion Isthmus
scenes.terrain: A narrow strip of land between two seas, packed with tiny streets.
scenes.landmark: A rooftop jazz club at the narrowest point, with the sea on both sides.
scenes.props: Brass instruments, mismatched chairs, potted plants, skateboards, a bridge with piano-key railings.

scenes.name: Garage Rock Row
scenes.terrain: A gritty small-town main street with garages, pubs and back alleys.
scenes.landmark: A row of open garages, each with a band set up inside, ending at a neon casino.
scenes.props: Muscle cars, pub signs, beer crates, leather jackets on hooks.

scenes.name: The Power Metal Peaks
scenes.terrain: Fantasy mountains with a stormy pirate cove below.
scenes.landmark: A castle on a peak with a dragon coiled around it and a pirate ship moored beneath.
scenes.props: Banners, swords, barrels, treasure chests, neon kawaii signs.

scenes.name: The Synthwave Coast
scenes.terrain: A coastal highway with palms beside a grid-lined sea.
scenes.landmark: A huge striped sun setting over the grid sea.
scenes.props: Palm trees, sports cars, cassettes, VHS tapes, pink neon signs.

scenes.name: The Velvet Rooftops
scenes.terrain: City rooftops at night, joined by sky bridges.
scenes.landmark: A rooftop pool lounge on top of a glowing tower.
scenes.props: Lounge chairs, neon signs, sports cars, a city skyline.

scenes.name: Discotopia
scenes.terrain: A glittering coastal town on terraced hills.
scenes.landmark: A lighthouse topped with a giant mirror ball.
scenes.props: Light-up dance floor tiles, platform shoes, conga drums, palm trees.

scenes.name: The 8-Bit Isle
scenes.terrain: A blocky island of pixel-stepped hills.
scenes.landmark: A pixel castle with a glowing save-point crystal at its gate.
scenes.props: Coins, farm plots, treasure chests, pixel trees, arcade cabinets.

scenes.name: The Old Jazz Quarter
scenes.terrain: Smoky hill towns with cobbled squares and stone bridges.
scenes.landmark: A club with a glowing marquee on a cobbled square, and a lone saxophonist on the bridge.
scenes.props: Street lamps, an upright bass, small cocktail tables, rain-slick cobbles.

scenes.name: The Bedroom Pop Meadows
scenes.terrain: Soft wildflower meadows and gentle hills.
scenes.landmark: A giant open-walled bedroom on a hill, with a bed, posters and fairy lights.
scenes.props: Fairy lights, posters, polaroids, bicycles, wildflowers.

scenes.name: The Electric Fields
scenes.terrain: Open festival fields on rolling hills.
scenes.landmark: A huge festival tent with a disco ball bursting out of the roof.
scenes.props: Flags, string lights, synths on hay bales, giant inflatables.

scenes.name: The Sample Gardens
scenes.terrain: Overgrown gardens built from collaged, mismatched pieces.
scenes.landmark: A giant marble-run machine winding through the garden.
scenes.props: Tape reels hanging in trees, old radios, wind-up toys, mismatched furniture.

scenes.name: Arena Rock Ridge
scenes.terrain: A long mountain ridge with a stadium carved into it.
scenes.landmark: A stadium bowl with spotlights sweeping the sky.
scenes.props: Lighters held up in the crowd, tour buses, spotlights, cowbells.

scenes.name: The Small Hours
scenes.terrain: A quiet hamlet of tiny cottages in a hollow.
scenes.landmark: A cluster of cottages, each with a lit window and a microphone inside.
scenes.props: Tape recorders, laptops, plants, a cat on the windowsill.

scenes.name: The Trip-Hop Undercity
scenes.terrain: A rainy harbour city that goes down into tunnels and vaults.
scenes.landmark: A cathedral-like tunnel with a lit stage, water dripping from the roof.
scenes.props: Vinyl crates, old TV sets, umbrellas, film-noir lamps.

scenes.name: The Electro Foundry
scenes.terrain: A sprawling robot factory on an artificial island.
scenes.landmark: A giant factory stage where robot arms play the instruments.
scenes.props: Conveyor belts, robot arms, sparks, warning stripes.

scenes.name: The Latin Coast
scenes.terrain: Colourful hillside towns running down to a warm bay.
scenes.landmark: A plaza with a bandstand in front of a whitewashed church.
scenes.props: Papel picado banners, cacti, piñatas, guitars, brightly painted houses.

scenes.name: Mount Virtuoso
scenes.terrain: Misty Celtic hills around one impossibly thin, tall peak.
scenes.landmark: A needle-thin peak with a tiny chapel on top, under an aurora.
scenes.props: Standing stones, harps, mist pools, a mysterious bucket shrine.

scenes.name: The Trance Steppe
scenes.terrain: Endless open grassland and sand flats.
scenes.landmark: A ring of obelisks firing lasers into the sky, like a laser Stonehenge.
scenes.props: Light pylons, strobes, sand dunes, distant speaker towers.

scenes.name: The Concert Isles
scenes.terrain: Manicured hills with tiered stone terraces, like the seats of an open-air concert hall, and formal gardens with clipped hedges.
scenes.landmark: A marble concert hall with a domed roof and a giant pipe organ facing the sea.
scenes.props: Grand pianos on lawns, music stands, statues of composers, chandeliers hung from old trees.

scenes.name: The Neo Soul Quarter
scenes.terrain: Warm brownstone streets on a low hill, with leafy courtyards and rooftop gardens.
scenes.landmark: A candlelit listening lounge in an old brownstone, its stoop full of record crates.
scenes.props: Incense smoke, vinyl players, houseplants, string lights, a corner bookstore.

scenes.name: The Liquid Rapids
scenes.terrain: Fast blue rivers and waterfalls rushing through smooth rock channels, with mist over everything.
scenes.landmark: A glass-floored rave stage built over the biggest waterfall, its speakers in time with the water.
scenes.props: Light poles pulsing at 174 bpm, rope bridges, glowing buoys, a hospital-white bandstand.

scenes.name: The Roots Bay
scenes.terrain: A sunny bay of palm-fringed beaches and green hills, with a fishing village on stilts.
scenes.landmark: A giant hand-painted sound system on the beach, stacked speaker boxes as tall as a house.
scenes.props: Painted shacks, hammocks, a ska dance hall, flags in red, gold and green.

scenes.name: The Delta Crossroads
scenes.terrain: Flat river delta with cotton fields, cypress swamps and dusty roads that meet at a crossroads.
scenes.landmark: A tin-roofed juke joint at the crossroads, lit by one bare bulb and a neon guitar sign.
scenes.props: Old guitars on porches, a railroad track, a rusting pickup, a river steamboat.

scenes.name: The Bluegrass Hollows
scenes.terrain: Blue-green Appalachian ridges with deep wooded hollows, creeks and split-rail fences.
scenes.landmark: A barn with its doors open on a front-porch stage, a picking circle always going.
scenes.props: Banjos, fiddles, mason jars, a covered bridge, a water mill.

scenes.name: The Afrobeat Coast
scenes.terrain: A lively coastal city of colourful markets, bright beaches and red-earth roads.
scenes.landmark: An open-air shrine-club with a horn section stage, like a big night in Lagos.
scenes.props: Market stalls of printed fabric, danfo buses, talking drums, beach bonfires.
